name: UW Blueprint
description: A student design team building free software (web and mobile apps, tools) for non-profit organizations.

cycles.notes: The application portal (uwblueprint.org/join-us) listed this cycle explicitly: 'Applications open Jul 1, 2026 6:00 PM and closes Jul 16, 2026 4:50 PM,' with final decisions around early August. That window has already passed. The site says general applications open roughly 2 months before each term starts. Separately, they're hiring VP Strategic Operations, Builder in Residence, VP Culture, and VP Growth, applications close Oct 12, 2026, that's exec hiring, not general membership.
